import html # Pre‑defined HTML template for a blog post. # The placeholders {headline} and {text} will be replaced with escaped user input. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{headline}

{text}
""" def display_blog_entry(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Format and sanitize a user‑submitted blog post for safe HTML display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. text : str The full body content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized, HTML‑formatted blog post. Notes ----- * Uses :func:`html.escape` to neutralise any special characters that could otherwise break the HTML structure or enable injection attacks. * The function assumes ``BLOG_FORMAT`` contains exactly two placeholders named ``{headline}`` and ``{text}``. """ # Escape user input to prevent XSS or HTML injection. safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Format the sanitized values into the template. formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(headline=safe_headline, text=safe_text) return formatted_post
